paragraphs: R' Yishmael ben Luga, in R' Akiva's time, Yoma 38a. Shir HaShirim Rabbah, chapter 3, on “Who is this,” reads Shimon ben Luga.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ר״ע is contextually read as Akiva, with abbreviated title retained as R'; the Yishmael title is likewise abbreviated. לח. gives Yoma 38a by the period convention, without fresh edition verification.

שהש״ר is read as Shir HaShirim Rabbah, chapter 3 on the verse Who is this. No new modern section number is supplied. Hyman reports Shimon ben Luga as its reading, distinct from Yishmael ben Luga; neither the common patronymic nor the source’s dating assertion establishes an identity merger. Shimon has no separate personal title and gains none.
